Solar Shades

Solar shades use screen-like fabric to filter sunlight while preserving some view outdoors. They are worth considering for bright windows where glare is part of everyday life.

Book a Consultation

Make room for the view.

Fabric openness changes the balance between the view and sun control. Your room's lighting and sightlines also matter when privacy is a priority. We will talk through how you use the room so you can compare solar shades with other shade styles before choosing.

What to consider

  • Which windows get the strongest sun
  • How much of the outdoor view you want to retain
  • The room's privacy needs and lighting
